title: Solana vs Hyperliquid: The $7B Gap Nobody's Talking About!
description:
Solana is dominating almost every vertical in crypto but falling behind in the one market that matters most: perps. 

With Hyperliquid doing ~$7B to ~$9B daily volume, the gap is real and it could determine whether Solana becomes the financial layer of the internet or falls short.

Here's why perps are the holy grail, why Hyperliquid is winning, and what Solana needs to fix before the window closes.
